newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia ready to work with Chechnya poll winner.
newsitem.headline: Russia ready to work with Chechnya poll winner.

text.p: The Russian government said on Tuesday it was ready to work with whoever wins Chechnya's presidential election, but had no comment on preliminary results of the poll.
"The government will look for a way to cooperate with whoever wins, provided the election is democratic, legitimate and there are no doubts," spokesman Igor Shabdurasulov told a news briefing.

The team of Chechen Prime Minister Aslan Maskhadov has already claimed victory in the election, which was held on Monday. Aide Mayerbek Vachagayev said early returns showed that Maskhadov had captured about 58 percent of the vote, against 30 percent for chief rival Shamil Basayev.
There has been no official confirmation, but at least one leading rival has acknowledged a Maskhadov victory.
If no candidate wins 50 percent in the first round, a second ballot will be held between the two top candidates.
